isolationStep.para: This data module provides fault isolation procedures for common Indicating and Recording System failures. Use BITE fault codes as starting point for troubleshooting. If no BITE code available, use symptom-based troubleshooting trees.

isolationStep.title: Symptom: Display Unit Blank or Dark

isolationStep.para: Check circuit breakers - verify display unit CB not tripped.
Check brightness setting - ensure not set to minimum.
Swap display with known-good unit from adjacent position. If fault follows display, replace display unit. If fault remains, suspect wiring or Display Management Computer.
Check BITE codes for Display Management Computer faults.

isolationStep.title: Symptom: Display Shows Incorrect or Frozen Data

isolationStep.para: Check data source selection - verify correct source selected for display.
Initiate display reversion test to verify switching logic operational.
Review AFDX network status - check for network faults or high utilization.
If data frozen, suspect Display Management Computer or IMA partition hosting display application.

isolationStep.title: Symptom: Display Has Dead Pixels or Discoloration

isolationStep.para: Minor pixel defects (<5 pixels) may be within tolerance - refer to CMM.
Perform color calibration to rule out calibration drift.
If extensive pixel damage or physical screen cracks present, replace display unit.
Perform master warning test from maintenance menu.
If light does not illuminate during test, check lamp and wiring.
If light works during test but not during actual warnings, suspect Crew Alerting Computer logic or configuration.
Review BITE fault codes for Crew Alerting Computer.
Review alert history to identify pattern (specific alert, flight phase, environmental conditions).
Check signal source - suspect faulty sensor or transducer if alert corresponds to specific parameter.
Verify alert threshold settings in configuration data.
If intermittent, suspect wiring or connector issues. Perform wiggle test while monitoring parameter.

isolationStep.title: Symptom: Aural Warnings Silent or Distorted

isolationStep.para: Perform aural warning test from maintenance menu.
Check crew headset connections and headset functionality.
If headset OK, check audio panel volume settings.
If aural warnings silent in all headsets/speakers, suspect audio management unit or Crew Alerting Computer audio output.
Check FDR status on maintenance page - note specific fault description.
Power cycle FDR (remove and reapply power via CB).
If fault persists, check data inputs to FDR - verify FDAU is providing data stream.
If FDAU operational, suspect FDR internal fault - replace FDR unit.
After replacement, download data from removed FDR for data recovery if required.
This is informational only - CVR automatically overwrites oldest data.
If data preservation required for incident investigation, remove CVR per regulatory procedures before further aircraft operation.
Check QAR removable memory module installed and seated correctly.
Remove and reseat module.
If fault persists, try known-good memory module.
If fault continues with good module, suspect QAR unit - replace QAR.

isolationStep.title: BITE Code: DAU-xxx (Data Acquisition Unit Fault)

isolationStep.para: Identify faulted DAU from BITE message (DAU-1 through DAU-4).
Review detailed DAU status for specific channel or port fault.
If specific input channel faulted, check sensor/transducer and wiring for that parameter.
If multiple channels faulted or DAU shows communication loss, suspect DAU unit - replace DAU.
After DAU replacement, verify all parameters from that DAU appear valid on displays.
